newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Kelon cancels Xian fridge deal.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Kelon cancels Xian fridge deal.

text.p: Guangdong Kelon Electrical Holdings Co Ltd said it had terminated a joint venture agreement with Huanghe Machinery & Electrical Co Ltd for establishing a refrigerator manufacturing firm Xian Kelon Refrigerator Co Ltd.

Guangdong Kelon said it had received a written request from Huanghe to terminate the joint venture agreement as Huanghe's parent was in the process of formalising a merger with another refrigerator maker, Changling Electrical Appliances Co.
Company chairman Pan Ning said in a statement the merger amounted to violation ofthe non-competition clause in the joint venture agreement.
Guangdong Kelon said it had not made any capital investment in the Xian venture and the termination of venture presented no potential liability.
The decision will have no impact on the company's forecasts for the year to December 31, 1996, the company said.
Guangdong Kelon was unchanged at HK$3.375 at midday.
